Gives you exceptional knowledge about your active quest, giving the location of needed items, or clues to solve difficult puzzles.
Teleports you to the person who gave you your active quest.
Half frog, half balloon. Uses its tongue to catch small creatures, like bats, bees and small spiders.

Returns to life any dead pet.

Favors granted by the God of Light, as a reward for destroying the undead.
Animates the skeleton of any humanoid you kill.\nEvery 5 levels in necromancy gives you control over one extra skeleton.
Draws out half of your life force. If you die later, that stored life returns, preventing death.
Creates a cloud that advances slowly consuming all life in its path.
Illuminates the mind for a moment, reducing the casting-time for all spells.
Stuns the victim for a few seconds, rendering it incapable of acting.

Transmutes a sapphire into 20 blue magic essences.
Transmutes an emerald into 20 green magic essences.
Metal mail, laced with leather strips to insulate the wearer from electricity.
Increases the capacity of your inventory letting you carry 10 more items.
Permanently alters the shape of your current weapon, causing it to inflict more damage.
When used against metallic enemies, transmutes some of that metal into coins.
Heals allied creatures (such as pets).\nDoes not work on undead.
Allows you to pick up items from a distance.
Permanently alters the material of a suit of armor or robe, increasing its protective qualities.
Immunizes you against any mental attack, such as stunning, sleep, or control.
Creates a reflective barrier.\nAll projectiles that strike the barrier are returned against the attacker.
Protects you against all spells that restrict or impose movement, such as slowness, paralysis, or teleportation.
A legendary sword that inflicts additional magic damage, and increases the wielder's gained experience.
The AN-200 Request form, stamped with a big rubber stamp. You have no idea what the stamp says.\nHand this over at the window with three skulls.
The AN-200 Request Form, complete with signature. It's even smudged in all the right places.\nThe guy at the skull/skull/bone window will want this.
The AN-200 Request Form. It has everything but the signature. Yours doesn't count.\nHand this over at the skull/bone/skull window.
Form 2212/HHK, the Form Request Form. Includes a blank for your tongue-print. The AN-200 Request Form has been checked.\nTurn this in at the skull/bone/bone window.
Now it's official: You're approved. Your parents would be proud.\nTake this approval letter to the bone/skull/skull window so you can finally get the order form.
The official seal of Harnakon. Trademarked in five countries.\nTake this to the bone/skull/bone window to get your official approval.
The official card given to Harnakon's minions. It has a blurry picture of you.\nTurn this in at the bone/bone/skull window.
Form MC-3805 (Official Minion Card Request).\nTurn this in at the window with three bones. No, skulls don't count as bones.
